files.patch:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -6,3 +6,3 @@ Back up a photo folder to an S3-compatible bucket.
 
-    snapback --bucket my-photos --concurrency 4 ~/Pictures
+    snapback --bucket my-photos --concurrency 4 --retries 3 ~/Pictures
 
@@ -12,3 +12,6 @@ Options:
 - `--concurrency <n>`: parallel uploads, default 4.
+- `--retries <n>`: retries per file after a network error or a 5xx reply, 0-10, default 3
+  (or `SNAPBACK_RETRIES`). Waits 200 ms, 400 ms, 800 ms, … (plus jitter, at most 10 s).
 
-The first failed upload stops the run.
+A file that still fails is listed at the end; the other files keep uploading. The exit code
+is 2 when any file failed.
